proposals.before: In Jianade 2 (573) he was made pillar-of-state.
proposals.after: In Jiande 2 (573) he was made pillar-of-state.
proposals.reason: Source reign name is 建德 (Jiande); "Jianade" is a misspelling.

proposals.before: His grandfather Wen served as governor of Ji Province.
proposals.after: His great-grandfather Wen served as governor of Ji Province.
proposals.reason: Chinese 曾祖 means great-grandfather, not grandfather.

proposals.before: Liang Yu — Guo Ganhui — Yi Feng — Liu Liang — Wang De
proposals.after: Liang Yu — Ruogan Hui — Yi Feng — Liu Liang — Wang De
proposals.reason: 若干 is the Xianbei surname Ruogan, not Guo; Guo Ganhui misrenders 若干惠.

proposals.before: Guo Ganhui, styled Huibao, came from Wuchuan in Dai commandery.
proposals.after: Ruogan Hui, styled Huibao, came from Wuchuan in Dai commandery.
proposals.reason: Same surname error: 若干 should be Ruogan, not Guo.

proposals.before: Guo Ganhui and Wang De were famed for bold resolve, yet also lived by filial duty—no small thing.
proposals.after: Ruogan Hui and Wang De were famed for bold resolve, yet also lived by filial duty—no small thing.
proposals.reason: Same 若干/Guo surname error in the historiographer appraisal.

proposals.before: Gan Hui sighed to himself: "My parents are old—when will I be able to give them something like this?"
proposals.after: Gan Hui sighed to himself: "My mother is old—when will I be able to give her something like this?"
proposals.reason: Earlier text states he lost his father early (早喪父); 親 here refers to his surviving parent.

decisions.reason: s0062 has 建德二年; Jianade is a misspelling of the Northern Zhou reign name Jiande, and the proposed replacement is otherwise unchanged and accurate.
s0067 has 曾祖文, which is great-grandfather (generation three), not grandfather; the preceding 高祖寬 confirms the generational ladder, so great-grandfather is the correct repair.
s0001 names 若干惠; 若干 is the Xianbei compound surname Ruogan, so Guo Ganhui is a false English rendering and Ruogan Hui restores the supported name.
s0028 opens 若干惠字惠保; the surname is 若干 (Ruogan), not Guo, and the given name is 惠 (Hui), so Ruogan Hui is the accurate personal name.
s0155 abbreviates to 惠、德, referring to 若干惠 and 王德 from this chapter; replacing the false Guo Ganhui with Ruogan Hui corrects the naming while keeping the appraisal sense intact.

decisions.after: Ruogan Hui sighed to himself: "My mother is old—when will I be able to give her something like this?"
decisions.reason: s0195 早喪父 shows his father was already dead, so s0197 親老矣 refers to the surviving mother, not plural parents; the proposed mother/her fix is right, but Gan Hui remains the false short form of Guo Ganhui and must be Ruogan Hui.

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted r0003/r0004 show English Guo Ganhui came only from the bad rendering of 若干惠; the personal-name claim must read Ruogan Hui while keeping zh, pinyin, id, subject, predicate, certainty, and evidence.
